Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study contains two distinct proteomics approaches: 1) A TMT-based total and phosphoproteomic analysis of mouse lung ECs (PXD030824), and 2) A label-free RIME (Rapid Immunoprecipitation Mass spectrometry of Endogenous proteins) analysis of HUVECs (PXD033447). Both are DDA-based. The phosphoproteomics component triggers mod_phospho, and the RIME component triggers mod_ap_ms.

organism: Primary mouse lung ECs preparations from ECFAKWT and ECFAKKO pups
scope: Rapid immunoprecipitation mass spectrometry of endogenous proteins

The FAK nuclear protein complexes were subjected to on-bead proteolytic digestion, desalting, and liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The input text describes two distinct MS experiments. One is a total/phosphoproteomic analysis of mouse lung EC lysates (PXD030824), and the other is a RIME (Rapid Immunoprecipitation Mass spectrometry of Endogenous proteins) experiment using HUVECs (PXD033447). Since the provided PRIDE metadata and the detailed RIME method focus on the affinity-purified FAK nuclear protein complexes, the scope is set to purified protein or complex. Mixed species flag is true because both human (HUVEC) and mouse (lung EC) materials were analyzed by MS.
